ruling.recommended_action: Issue rider a Ryde voucher of $3.94 (unexempted detour mileage, incl. the unannounced 7-Eleven detour; the metered stop-wait $1.08 is not refundable) and remind driver that an off-route stop must be agreed before leaving the optimal route.

segment_findings.reason: Off-route drive + stop at a 7-Eleven ~2.9 km off the optimal route (17:41–17:45, stationary 1.31349,103.88838). Rider named only 'a 7-Eleven on the way' and the driver did not disclose the chosen location before leaving the optimal route; the driver's own 'Ok' (17:33:55) does not amount to agreement to this route change (RD-3(b), RD-5). No traffic incident and only band 4 on this corridor, so RD-4 gives no exemption. extra_km counted under RD-2.

Post-stop wrong-carriageway excursion across to ~103.900 and U-turn back via 1.331/103.920 to rejoin the optimal line (17:45:40–17:50:55). Never requested by the rider and no pre-departure agreement (RD-5), no traffic incident (RD-4); net extra lateral km counted under RD-2.
